paite: Hiai tengteng ka lungtang in ka vei ngal a, hiai tengteng zongkhe ding in; midiktatte leh mipilte leh athilhihte uh Pathian khut ah a-om ahi chih; itna ahi hia muhdahna, mihing in athei kei; ama uah avek in a-om hi.
heading: Nuamtak In Om In
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

paite: Thil tengteng kibang in avek ua kiang ah ahong om a; midiktatte leh migiloute tung ah tanchin khat a-om hi; mihoih kiang leh migilou kiang, misiang kiang leh misiang lou kiang, kithoihmi kiang leh kithoihloumi kiang ah, mihoih a-om bang in, mikhial a-om a; akichiampa, thuchiam kihtapa bang in.
english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

paite: Ni nuai ah hih a om tengteng ah hiai gilou ahi, bang teng tung a tanchin khat om; ahi nalai a, mite tapate lungtang gilou in adim a, adam lai uh alungtang uah lungsim kimlouhna a-om, huai nung in misite kiang ah apai uh.
english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

paite: Amah hing lai tengteng toh kizom a om ding in lah lametna a-om ngal a; humpinelkai sisa sang in ui hing lai lah ahoihzaw ngal a.
english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

paite: Mihingte'n asi ding uh chih lah athei ngal ua; himahleh misi in thil himhim athei kei, kipahman leng aneita kei uhi; amaute theihgigena lah akimangngilh hi.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

paite: A-itna uh bang in, amuhdahna uleh a-enna uh tu in amangta a; ni nuai a hih a om thil himhim ah tangtawn in tantuan anei nawnta kei uhi.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

paite: Pai inla, nopsakna toh na tanghou ne inla, lungtang kipak toh in na uain dawn in; Pathian in lah na thilhihte asang khinta ngal a.
english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

paite: Na puansilhte ngou gige in om hen; huan na lu in nilh theih tasam kei hen.
english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

paite: Na bangmah lou damsung ni tengteng a na it na zi kiang ah kipaktak in om inla, huai ama'n ni nuai a ahon piak, na bangmah lou ni tengteng in; huai lah damsung in na tantuan ahi ngal a, ni nuai a na sepgimna a na sepgimna ah.
english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

paite: Na khut in hih ding bangpeuh amuh na theihtawp in sem in; na paina lam han sung ah, nasep hiam, thil ngaihtuah hiam, theihna hiam, pilna hiam a-om lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

paite: Ka kihei a, kitaitehna kinte a ding ahi kei a, galdouna hatte a ding ahi tuan kei chih ka mu hi, tanghou leng apilte a ding, hauhsakna leng theisiam mite a ding, deihsakna khutsiamte a ding hi tuan lou; himahleh hun leh phat amaute tengteng tung ah ahong om zel hi.
english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

paite: Mihing in ahun athei kei hi; ngasate len gilou a akimat bang leh vasate thang a a-awk uh bang in, huchibang in mite tapate, amau tung a thakhat a ahong tun guih lai in, hun gilou a mat in a-om uhi.
english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

paite: Hichibang in pilna leng ni nuai ah ka mu a, ka kiang ah thupi in akilang hi.
heading: Pilna Leh Haina Ngaihtuahnate
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

paite: Khopi lian lou a-om a, asung ah mi tawmchik; huan kumpipa thupi in ahong sim a, ala a, adouna ding in sepaih nasep thupitak abawl hi.
english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

paite: Huchi in huai ah mipil genthei khat a-om, apilna in khopi ahunkhia a; himahleh kuamah in huai migentheipa atheigige kei uh.
english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

paite: Huan ke'n, "Hatna sang in pilna ahoihzaw; migenthei pilna muhsit in a-om a, athute ngaihkhiaksak in a-om kei," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

paite: Mihaite lak a vaihawmmi kikou sang in awl a mipil thugente akiza zaw hi.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

paite: Kidouna galvante sang in pilna ahoihzaw; himahleh mikhial khat in hoih tampi ahihsia hi.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
